# moneybin categories

Usage: `moneybin categories [OPTIONS] COMMAND [ARGS]...`

|---|---|---|---|
| `CATEGORY_ID` | text | yes | Category ID to update |

**Options**

| Option | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--active / --inactive` | flag | `true` | Set category active or inactive |

## moneybin categories delete

Hard-delete a user-created category.

Refuses if the category is referenced by transactions or budgets unless
--force is passed. Default (seeded) categories cannot be deleted — disable
them with `moneybin categories set <id> --inactive` instead.

Usage: `moneybin categories delete [OPTIONS] CATEGORY_ID`

**Arguments**

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `CATEGORY_ID` | text | yes | Category ID to delete |

**Options**

| Option | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--force` | flag |  | Cascade-delete referencing transactions and budgets instead of refusing |
| `-o, --output` | one of `text`, `json` | `text` | Output format: 'text' (human-readable) or 'json' (machine-readable). |
